title: Ruby Nox wins Drag Race Brasil Season 2
summary: In the Grand Finale (BR-S02-E10), Melina Blley and Poseidon Drag were eliminated as the final four narrowed to two, leaving Ruby Nox and Mellody Queen to lip-sync to Rosana Fiengo's "O Amor e o Poder". Ruby Nox won the Lip Sync for the Crown and was named Drag Race Brasil's next Drag Superstar; Mellody Queen finished as runner-up.

title: Chanel: Season 2's first Porkchop
summary: Chanel was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Brasil season 2 (BR-S02-E02), losing "Ultra Som" by Pabllo Vittar to Poseidon Drag.

title: Rinha de Lipsync LaLaPaRuZa twist
summary: In BR-S02-E07, the six remaining queens faced a Lip-Sync LaLaPaRuZa Smackdown: Melina Blley beat Bhelchi, Poseidon Drag beat Adora Black, and Mellody Queen beat Ruby Nox in the first round. The three round-one winners then saved Bhelchi from the decider, sending Ruby Nox and Adora Black to lip-sync to "Sissy That Walk". Ruby Nox won and Adora Black was eliminated.
